Balance Sheet — Equity — Group — Name

Configure the name for the equity group on the balance sheet.

This customizes how the equity section appears in financial reports.

Name

Enter a custom name for the equity section. Leave blank to use the default 'Equity' label.

The equity section represents the owners' residual interest in the business after all liabilities are paid.

Alternative names might include 'Shareholders' Equity', 'Members' Equity', 'Partners' Capital', or 'Net Worth'.

This name appears as a main heading on the Balance Sheet report.
